description: Dependency updates for garfin. Renovate's pull requests go through reviewer-bot, CI and merge-bot like any other, and none is merged automatically.
A release must be three days old before it is proposed; a release whose date the registry does not publish is still proposed.
Updates arrive once a week, one pull request per manager group (pub, gradle, GitHub Actions), so a week of bumps is one review each rather than many.
dev.flutter.flutter-plugin-loader is ignored: it ships inside the Flutter SDK and is not published to Maven, so its lookup can only fail and put a warning on the dashboard.

A pull request is rebased whenever it falls behind main, not only when it conflicts: the merge desk needs main as an ancestor, so one that is merely behind would otherwise wait for someone to tick its rebase box.
